name: Jackson County, MO
findings: Jackson County has 3,278 nonprofit organizations. 1,407 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,130 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jackson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
